candidate_workaround: Add decision-relevant successor instructions and measure the generated baton before closeout writes.
failure_signature: A generated successor activation baton is substantive but remains below its preregistered word floor.
recurrence_guard: Measure baton length before writes and require every added section to carry a decision, gate, or falsifier.
rollback: Retain the failed build, leave routing unsent, and do not weaken the declared word contract.
title: Measure decision-relevant successor batons before seal
trigger_preconditions: A generated activation baton has a declared 4,000-to-6,000-word contract.
